nodes.description: Address of the contract developer/owner, set to msg.sender at deployment and used as the sole access-control authority.
Public token price in wei per token (0.04 ether), used in the buyTokens payment check and modifiable by the dev via setPrice.
Dynamic array of participant addresses; each token purchase pushes the buyer's address into it and winners are drawn from it.
Total number of lottery entries; incremented on every purchase and used as the modulo bound for randomness.
Reference to the SecretSantaERC20 token contract, used for balanceOf and the external transfer call in buyTokens.
Payable public function that sells tokens for ETH, performs an external token.transfer, appends the buyer to lotteryBag and increments numEntries.
Dev-only function that derives two pseudo-random indices from block.timestamp/difficulty and sends ETH prizes to two winners.
Dev-only function that derives one pseudo-random index from block.timestamp/difficulty and announces a winner with zero payout.
Dev-only function that overwrites the token price state variable.
Dev-only function that transfers the entire contract ETH balance to the dev address.
View function returning the current token price.
View function returning the full array of lottery entries.
View function returning the number of lottery entries.
Modifier enforcing msg.sender == _dev; guards announceWinners, announceRaffleWinner, setPrice and withdrawAll.
Caller-controlled address; used for access control (_devOnly), recorded as the buyer/lottery participant and used as the constructor owner.
Miner-influenceable timestamp used with block.difficulty as the entropy source for winner selection.
External call token.transfer(sender, amount) executed before the lotteryBag and numEntries state updates.
ETH value transfer of winnings to the first winner address drawn from the lottery bag.
ETH value transfer of winnings2 to the second winner address drawn from the lottery bag.
ETH value transfer of the whole contract balance to the dev address in withdrawAll.
State update of numEntries (and lotteryBag pushes) that occurs after the external token.transfer call.
User-supplied token amount parameter of buyTokens.
New price value supplied to setPrice.
Local copy of msg.sender used as the recipient of token.transfer and as a lottery entry.
Local copy of msg.value compared against _price * amount.
Local holding token.balanceOf(address(this)) used to validate the reserve.
First pseudo-random index derived from block.timestamp, block.difficulty and numEntries.
Second pseudo-random index derived from random and numEntries.
First winner address selected from lotteryBag.
Second winner address selected from lotteryBag.
Local copy of the contract ETH balance used to compute prize amounts.
Prize for the first winner (_balance/5), sent via transfer.
Prize for the second winner (_balance/20), sent via transfer.
Payable address of the dev used as the recipient of the full balance transfer.
Local copy of address(this).balance transferred out in withdrawAll.

edges.reason: msg.sender is copied into the local sender variable inside buyTokens.
The user-controlled sender address is passed as the recipient of the external token.transfer call.
The user-supplied amount parameter is passed directly into the external token.transfer call.
The user-supplied amount is used to increment numEntries.
amount is multiplied by _price when computing the required payment, a user-influenced arithmetic expression.
The _price state variable participates in the _price * amount multiplication checked against ethPaid.
The token contract reference is used to read dexBalance via balanceOf.
msg.sender is compared to _dev inside the _devOnly modifier.
The _dev state variable is the reference value used for the access-control check.
announceWinners is guarded by the _devOnly modifier.
announceRaffleWinner is guarded by the _devOnly modifier.
setPrice is guarded by the _devOnly modifier.
withdrawAll is guarded by the _devOnly modifier.
block.timestamp is hashed into the first pseudo-random index, creating miner-influenceable randomness.
block.timestamp-derived randomness propagates into the second index via random.
announceWinners outcome depends directly on block.timestamp (timestamp dependency).
announceRaffleWinner outcome depends directly on block.timestamp (timestamp dependency).
numEntries is used as the modulo bound when deriving the random index.
numEntries is used as the modulo bound when deriving random2.
numEntries is the state variable updated by the amount increment.
random is used as the array index to select the first winner from lotteryBag.
lotteryBag supplies the first winner address selected by random.
random2 is used as the array index to select the second winner from lotteryBag.
lotteryBag supplies the second winner address selected by random2.
The first winner address is used as the recipient of the ETH transfer.
The second winner address is used as the recipient of the ETH transfer.
winnings is computed from the contract balance (_balance/5).
winnings2 is computed from the contract balance (_balance/20).
winnings is the value transferred to the first winner.
winnings2 is the value transferred to the second winner.
The external token.transfer call is executed before the lotteryBag pushes and numEntries state update, violating checks-effects-interactions ordering.
The token contract reference is the callee of the external transfer call.
buyTokens pushes the buyer address into lotteryBag inside the purchase loop.
The dev address _dev is converted to a payable recipient inside withdrawAll.
The dev address _to is the recipient of the full balance transfer.
The contract balance read into _balance is the amount transferred out.
The setPrice parameter overwrites the _price state variable.
getPrice returns the _price state variable.
getTicketBag returns the lotteryBag array.
getNumEntries returns the numEntries state variable.
The constructor assigns msg.sender to _dev, establishing the privileged account.

normalization_plan.reason: The amount parameter has no meaning outside buyTokens; it flows directly into the external token.transfer call and should be merged into that unsafe operation.
The _newPrice parameter is only consumed by setPrice and should be normalized into that function node.
The local sender is a copy of msg.sender used solely as the transfer recipient and should be merged into the external transfer operation.
The ethPaid local is a transient copy of msg.value used only inside buyTokens and should be merged into the enclosing function.
The dexBalance local is a transient read of the token reserve used only inside buyTokens and should be merged into the enclosing function.
The random local is a transient index derived from block.timestamp inside announceWinners and should be merged into that function.
The random2 local is a transient index computed inside announceWinners and should be merged into that function.
The winner local exists only to be the recipient of the ETH transfer and should be merged into that unsafe operation.
The winner2 local exists only to be the recipient of the ETH transfer and should be merged into that unsafe operation.
The _balance local is a transient snapshot of address(this).balance used only inside announceWinners and should be merged into that function.
The winnings local is only the value sent by the first winner transfer and should be merged into that unsafe operation.
The winnings2 local is only the value sent by the second winner transfer and should be merged into that unsafe operation.
The _to local is the recipient of the balance transfer and should be merged into that unsafe operation.
The _balance local is only the amount of the balance transfer and should be merged into that unsafe operation.
